title: Area2Ds added to a disabled parent are not registered as overlapping after enabling the parent
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.1.stable.official
(but should be reproducible in older versions)

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

When adding overlapping `Area2D` to a disabled node in the tree, the areas are not detected as overlapping after their parent has been re-enabled. In particular:

1. The `area_entered` signal is never emitted
1. Even worse: `get_overlapping_areas` returns an empty array, so no easy workaround is possible

This is a long-standing issue with Area2D's that can not be easily worked around afaik.

**Why is this relevant?**

A game that streams its game world as chunks might add the children of a chunk distributed over several frames. The chunk might be disabled while the adding of children goes on and only enabled after all children have been added.

_Note:_

Various fixes around Areas and pausing/disabling the tree have been pushed over time, but this issue bothers me to this day. There might be an open issue describing exactly this issue, but I haven't found it.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run the MRP
2. Observe log "Area entered signals were NOT emitted after enabling parent."

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[area-resume-disabled-parent-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23878698/area-resume-disabled-parent-mrp.zip)
